title: red: wipe failure mid-conversion bricks the session (mode toggled, inner handle closed)
description: convertDurableToIncognito: read->close->wipe->buffer. If rmSync fails after close, modeStore is already incognito and the durable handle is closed; appends through the facade handle then throw SessionHandleClosedError and the on-disk artifact survives. Reproduction idea: chmod the session dir's parent read-only before toggle. Fix idea: on wipe failure reopen the durable handle and swap it back as backing before rethrowing (or wipe via a staged rename that is atomic).
